# BCPack decoder notices

bcpack.rs, bcpack/tables.rs and bcpack/vectors.rs are ported from Xbox2Windows
(src/startup_stubs/bcpack_decoder.h, bcpack_tables.h, tests/startup_stub_consumer.cpp at
90e84561), MIT. That port and its tables carry the notices below, reproduced from
Xbox2Windows tools/_bcpack_rans/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.


## Microsoft silicon-rans

`src/tables.rs`, `python/bcpack_tables.py`, and `src/startup_stubs/bcpack_tables.h` contain the rANS model tables
(`base_table`, `freq_table`, `rf_table`, `rs_table`, `rn_table`) of `mdu_minirans.v` from
https://github.com/microsoft/silicon-rans (commit 2f6827d), generated by `tools/gen_tables.py`.
The per-lane decoder in `src/rans.rs`, `python/bcpack.py`, and `src/startup_stubs/bcpack_decoder.h` is a port of
that file's `decoder` module. It is used under the following license:

## Ahmet Dedeler bcpack-rs

`src/startup_stubs/bcpack_tables.h` contains BC7 and BC1 codebook, window, and dictionary tables
(`BC7_CONTROL_TABLE`, `BC7_DICTIONARY`, `BC1_WINDOW`, `BC1_QUAD_MASKS`) adapted from
https://github.com/Ahmet-Dedeler/bcpack-rs (pinned revision c55c5fad539644b8cf5a705051df214291763fc0).
The BC7 and BC1 block reconstruction routines in `src/startup_stubs/bcpack_decoder.h` are adapted from
